summary: Verified new per-customer BILLING TERM feature end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (added 6 new tests: revenue_customers endpoint, billing_terms persistence via PUT+GET, parametrized MRR-spread rule for annual/quarterly/monthly, and default-monthly-when-absent). Core rule verified: 1200 EUR single-row invoice spreads to 12x100 (annual), 3x400 (quarterly), 1x1200 (monthly/absent) in results.mrr_series.data. Frontend: BillingTerms section renders on /audit/{id}/mapping when revenue is uploaded and service dates are NOT mapped. Lists 5 customers from sample_data/revenue.csv, apply-all-annual sets CUST-1 select to 'annual', per-customer manual select works, search-input filters (typed 'CUST-2' -> 1 visible row), Confirm mapping persists billing_terms={'CUST-1':'annual'} to backend. When service_start AND service_end are mapped, the per-customer list disappears (0 rows) and explanatory note 'per-customer billing terms aren't needed' is visible. Regression: existing seeded demo audits still open, full upload+compute flow still works (test_save_mapping_and_compute passing).
critical_code_review_comments: growth_engine.build_mrr_matrix correctly uses billing_terms.get(cust,'monthly') and TERM_MONTHS map; unknown term strings fall back to 1 month via .get(term,1) which is safe.

server.save_mapping persists billing_terms in the dataset doc; compute_audit passes ds['revenue']['billing_terms'] into config; audit_public exposes billing_terms in datasets.revenue payload — flow is clean.

MappingWizard BillingTerms component correctly re-fetches customers on customerCol change, and short-circuits to explanatory note when hasServiceDates is true. Note: when hasServiceDates is true the wrapper div no longer carries data-testid='billing-terms-section' — this matches the spec (per-customer list absent), but if a test wants to assert 'section visible with note', a testid on the alt branch would help. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ audits created and deleted per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing terms feature verified. Regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (16 tests including parametrized MRR-spread). Frontend selectors used: billing-terms-section, billing-row-{cust}, billing-term-{cust}, billing-apply-all-{term}, billing-search-input, confirm-mapping-button-revenue, compute-button.
